question: Can the prescribed synthetic affine label map and a constant baseline be captured and reproduced honestly across fresh contexts?
assumptions: n is an integer event index with declared tick unit, not a measured clock or native UD object.
Labels are synthetic exact rational numbers with declared ns units, not empirical data.
An affine family and unweighted least-squares objective are imposed for this demonstration.
No noise model or parameter uncertainty is supplied.
physical_mapping: ASSUMED: t_label_ns = offset_ns + scale_ns_per_tick * n. Offset has ns units; scale has ns/tick units. No physical realization, reference frame, UD clock law, or causal mechanism is established.

mapping_components.native_quantities: None: n is an abstract event index.
mapping_components.assumed: Affine map, tick/ns naming, exact rational labels.
mapping_components.fitted: offset_ns and scale_ns_per_tick using training only.
mapping_components.derived_under_assumptions: Residuals and SSE on all disclosed points.

baseline: Constant training mean 3 ns; residuals prediction-label: training [2,0,-2] ns, exposed evaluation [-4,-6] ns; SSE training 8 ns^2, evaluation 52 ns^2.
result: FIT + EXACT: affine offset 1 ns, slope 2 ns/tick; residuals [0,0,0] ns training and [0,0] ns exposed evaluation; both SSE zero.
search_disclosure: Two prescribed model families evaluated; no formula search or hyperparameter tuning. All five labels were known before code and fit; exposed evaluation is development evaluation.
identifiability: Nonconstant training indices identify affine parameters within that family. Other function families can match all five labels; mechanism and physical identification remain open.
limitations: No empirical measurements, uncertainty model, native UD derivation or independent prediction.
Exact arithmetic proves the calculation within imposed premises only.
Constructor checks and fresh-context LLM reproduction are not independent empirical replication.
This candidate carries no physical or mainline promotion.
next_discriminant: First reproduce this frozen artifact in the separate reviewer workspace. Any physical investigation needs a defined native readout, explicit unit realization and a frozen map evaluated on genuinely unused measurements.
target_exposure: FULLY EXPOSED before fitting: training (0,1),(1,3),(2,5) and evaluation (3,7),(4,9), labels in ns; FIT/development evaluation only.
